title: Ellaz fight match file
description: The rules of a bout, all of them integers and all of them TICKS at tickRate. Nothing here is a duration in seconds and nothing here is a fraction: a float would have to be divided somewhere, and fixed.ts is the only file allowed to divide.

knockScale.description: a knock/impulse vector is frame px; after the draw scale it is multiplied by this to become view px per second

liftScale.description: the vertical knock/impulse component's multiplier, frame px after the draw scale -> view px per second. Separate from knockScale because gravity (900 px/s^2) eats a small lift within a tick or two: at 10 the robot's authored dy -20 reached an apex of 0.9 view px (measured 2026-09-12), invisible; at 60 it is a 32 px hop

hitZBand.description: view px of z separation a hit still crosses. Must be comfortably above an ai's zTolerance (5), or an opponent that believes it has lined up the lane cannot reach; 12 is twice that plus slack, against a 158 px deep arena and a fighter about 34 view px wide.

fallThreshold.description: accumulated `fall` points that knock a standing fighter down. 60 = three of the robot's swings (fall 20) or five of the teddy's (fall 12), which agrees with hitsToKnockdown for the heavier attack and asks more of the lighter one. It must stay ABOVE (hitsToKnockdown - 1) x the largest authored fall, or a fighter falls a hit early and hitsToKnockdown stops meaning anything.

friction.description: a sliding fighter keeps (friction-1)/friction of its vx each tick, so the total slide is about vx x friction. 8 gives the robot's 512 FP knock ~16 view px of travel and its 409 FP walk ~13 px of skid - momentum, not ice. The minimum is 2 and not 0: fixed.ts would divide by zero, and 1 is an instant stop.

hitstopTicks.description: everyone freezes this long when a hit lands

knockdownWindowTicks.description: how long recent hits stay recent
